elements.name: Stage the same command for two ribbon tabs

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software
the ribbon customization dialog has empty Part Tools and Part Manage targets
the command source is All Commands
the user double-clicks 2D Sketches in the source list for Part Tools
the command appears in the Part Tools target and the target is marked as changed
the user selects the Part Manage target
the target is empty and 2D Sketches is available in the source list
the user double-clicks 2D Sketches in the source list
the command appears in the Part Manage target and that target is marked as changed
the user returns to the Part Tools target
its staged 2D Sketches command remains present
the Part Tools target is marked as changed
